The '''Proudspire''' is the largest mountain within [[Varlamore]], being part of the [[Hailstorm Mountains]], the range flanking the capital of [[Civitas illa Fortis]]. It is famous enough that Emperor [[Imafore Tullus]] gave the Kourend royal family a tour of "the peak of the Proudspire", among other places.{{CiteText|text=Imafore's betrayal|quote=From the floating city of Tempestus to the peak of the Proudspire, he showed them everything that Varlamore had to offer.}}

The Proudspire is mainly visited by players through [[Treasure Trails]], directing them to dig near the [[Obelisk (Proudspire)|obelisk]]. There are two [[Agility]] [[shortcuts]] on the path to the peak, with the [[Rocks (The Proudspire, lower)|lower shortcut]] requiring 45 Agility and the [[Rocks (The Proudspire, upper)|upper shortcut]] requiring 71 Agility. Other than that, there are currently no other useful features at its peak. The [[Twilight Temple]] teleport on the [[Pendant of Ates]] is the closest teleport. Slightly further, the peak is equidistant from the [[Quetzacalli Gorge]] quetzal and [[Salvager Overlook]] quetzal. Players may wish to bring a [[stamina potion]] as it is nearly 400 tiles from the peak to any teleport if not using the shortcuts.

==History==
The mountain is a holy site within the Varlamorian religion of [[Losanium]]. Accordingly, it is overseen by two [[teoki]]: [[Yolotli, Teoki of Ralos|Yolotli]] and [[Ezco, Teoki of Ranul|Ezco]]. Dedicated followers of Losanium may undertake a sacred pilgrimage, walking from the [[Teomat]], past [[Mons Gratia]], to the [[Obelisk (Proudspire)|obelisk]] atop the Proudspire.

The Proudspire was also the site of a key battle during the War of Betrayal that led to the capture and execution of Emperor Imafore.{{CiteNPC|npc=Curator Herminius|quote=Imafore soon found himself facing as much resistance from within as he did from Kourend. The end result was predictable. Imafore and his forces found themselves trapped between two armies at the Battle of the Proudspire. He was captured and executed, bringing an end to the Tullus dynasty.}}

The obelisk at the peak of Proudspire is a large monument of reddish-brown stone with carvings depicting various figures on its four sides and is surrounded by four carved [[Obelisk Hand|statues of hands]] reaching up from the ground. The bottom of the north face of the obelisk appears to be "leaking" some form of purple liquid or corruption, but cannot currently be entered into. Based on the four hand statues surrounding the obelisk, it may be depicting a [[nagua]], who have four arms and therefore four hands.

The obelisk's exact origins and purpose are unknown, but it remains sacred to the people of Varlamore since it was of religious importance to the [[Old Ones]], who built it.{{CiteNPC|npc=Yolotli, Teoki of Ralos|quote=It was built by those who wandered these lands before we did. They worshipped Ralos and Ranul just as we now do. The obelisk was a site of great religious importance to them, and so it is to us as well.}} In particular, the Sect of Ranul is interested in the obelisk because of how it signifies the importance of preserving knowledge.{{CiteNPC|npc=Yolotli, Teoki of Ralos|quote=[The purpose of the obelisk] is something we sadly don't know. It is why the obelisk is especially important to those who serve Ranul. It is a reminder of the importance in ensuring knowledge is preserved.}}

===Mining site===
Just to the north-east of the Proudspire lies a [[South Salvager Overlook mine|mine]] with the following rocks:
* 7 [[Coal rocks|coal]]
* 3 [[Mithril rocks|mithril]]
* 2 [[Adamantite rocks|adamantite]]
